DOCKER_HOST.description: The Docker daemon to use, as for any docker command. Default: the Docker CLI's current context.

OSF_DATA.description: Folder where start records each gateway that it attached to a running proxy, as gateways/<ID>.json with the proxy's URL and the name of the master key's variable, and the hashed tokens of its run keys as gateways/<ID>.keys. It never holds a key's value.

OSF_SECRET_*.description: OSF_SECRET_<NAME> holds a value the config names as os.environ/OSF_SECRET_<NAME>, such as a provider key, or the master key of a running proxy that osf.proxy.master_key names. The Docker CLI hands a provider key to the LiteLLM container only; it is never in the config.
